datasets.title: Global Human Settlement Layer - settlement characteristics (GHS-BUILT-C) - Mollweide 10 m
datasets.description: GHS Settlement Characteristics (e.g. vegetation surfaces, water surfaces, residential versus non-residential zones) derived from Sentinel2 composite (2018) and other GHS R2023A data in Mollweide coordinates at 10 m spatial resolution. MSZ: classification by internal surface (soil sealed), functional (BU RES/NRES) characteristics, and building height; RES vs. NRES: functional classification of the built domain defined as BUFRAC>0 [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the STAC catalog climate-risk-stac (https://climate-risk-data.github.io/climate-risk-stac/)]
